case_number: 2025 INSC 52; Petition for Special Leave to Appeal (C) No.25246/2023
summary: Specific performance of contract; Section 12(3) Specific Relief Act, 1963; part performance not severable; plaintiff not ready and willing to perform; failure to pay full consideration; claim for damages incompatible with Section 12(3)(ii) relinquishment requirement; High Court affirmed; discretion under Section 12 not arbitrarily exercised; relief denied.
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; order of High Court upholding dismissal of appeal affirmed; relief denied.
